name: search_products
description: Search the shop. Every word of the query must occur in the product name or category. Returns the matching products with id, name, category, price (EUR), rating (0-5), availability and badge.

query.description: search words; empty string lists all products

sort.description: price low to high, price high to low, rating high to low

name: get_product
description: Show all information about one product, including stock and description.

name: get_cart
description: Show the cart: items with unit price, quantity, line total and availability, and the total.

name: add_to_cart
description: Add a quantity of a product to the cart. Returns the cart.

name: update_cart_item
description: Set the quantity of a product that is already in the cart. Returns the cart.

name: remove_from_cart
description: Remove a product from the cart. Returns the cart.

name: checkout
description: Place the order for all items in the cart (no payment needed). Returns the order.
